== Biography ==

Dyna is an old woman living in the Emerald City. She is a relative of the crooked Sorcerer who invented the magic Powder of Life; when the Sorcerer fell down a precipice and was killed, all his possessions passed to her. Dyna traveled to the mountains where the Sorcerer had lived and took away everything she considered of value, including a small bottle of the Powder of Life — though she did not know it was magic.

Dyna once kept a large blue bear as a pet, until it choked to death on a fishbone. She loved the bear so dearly that she made a rug from its skin, leaving the head and four paws on the hide, and kept the rug on the floor of her front parlor.
